criterion: Every system operation must derive from a pre-registered data contract or defined physical/logical invariant; ungrounded operational claims are discarded.
fail_closed_condition: Deployment readiness is false until the operation names its governing invariant or data contract.
invariant_or_contract: CLAIMS.md evidence tiers plus invariant registry contracts in CLAUDE.md and runtime/INVARIANTS.yaml.
validation_gate: Reject any promotion when no claim tier, contract pointer, or invariant identifier is present.

criterion: Every module or function must have an explicit falsification-ledger mapping, mapped unit/property test, and declared fail-closed condition.
fail_closed_condition: Module remains non-deployable until property/unit evidence and failure mode are recorded.
invariant_or_contract: Structural deployment contract: module-to-test mapping plus fail-closed condition.
validation_gate: Reject deployment when mapped test evidence or falsification notes are absent.

criterion: Execution state must be immutable where possible and deterministic; side effects must remain isolated behind declared control gates.
fail_closed_condition: Execution halts or rolls back when replay evidence diverges from the recorded transition.
invariant_or_contract: Deterministic replay contract: same inputs, seed, versions, and gate decisions must reproduce state transitions.
validation_gate: Reject state transitions that drift under replay in a standard compliant environment.

criterion: All significant claims, evidence, and deployment metadata must be attributable to repository history and accepted signed identity artifacts.
fail_closed_condition: Deployment is blocked until repository history and accepted signature evidence identify the actor or service principal.
invariant_or_contract: Provenance contract: Git object integrity plus signed commit, signed tag, GPG, KMS, or HSM-backed attestation.
validation_gate: Reject deployment metadata when attributable identity evidence is missing from the external provenance boundary.
